The provided evidence is an abstract of a comprehensive review paper on nanofluid minimum quantity lubrication (MQL) across turning, milling, and grinding. 

The candidate hypothesis introduces highly specific, fabricated quantitative parameters and claims—such as establishing a self-sustaining tribological layer with a thickness of 1–10 μm, hardness of 500–1000 HV, friction coefficient of 0.1–0.3, specific concentration ranges (0.1–1.0 vol%), and specific cutting parameter windows—none of which are proposed, tested, or stated as the central hypothesis of the review study in the provided text.

VERDICT: REJECT
